description: Week 32 (2026-11-02; Dr. Luitel, 2026-11-02: every pretrained spectrogram model, with my heads tuned on each): w2v-BERT 2.0 (facebook/w2v-bert-2.0; a Conformer pretrained without labels on 4.5 million hours of speech), frozen, reading the 80-band mel filterbank its own feature extractor makes; each of its 25 layers' mean vector per utterance (over the frames its feature extractor marks real) with the SVM of night 30's classical_pretrained_whisper_large_v3_so3_1, whose settings this sweep keeps except the feature set. Seed 1. The layer with the highest mean validation macro accuracy over the 5 folds is chosen, a tie to the lower layer (RULE_week32.txt part 6). How the results are read is fixed in RULE_week32.txt (analyses/week32_prep_20261102) before any run. Runs on CPUs in the classical environment.
